name: The Supernatural
overview: Scripture clearly warns against engaging with supernatural practices outside of God's ordained revelation, condemning witchcraft, familiar spirits, diviners, and wizards as defiling and opposed to the LORD's will (Exodus 22:18; Leviticus 19:31; Deuteronomy 18:14). The biblical narrative exposes the futility and judgment upon those who seek guidance from such sources rather than trusting in God, as seen in God's judgment on Egypt's reliance on charmers and wizards (Isaiah 19:3). Furthermore, God denounces deceptive spiritual leaders who exploit His people through false supernatural claims (Ezekiel 13:18). Instead, believers are called to bless and remember the LORD and His benefits, placing their trust solely in Him (Psalms 103:2).
